name: 25B-NBOH
summary: A phenethylamine psychedelic  and stimulant derivative of 2C-B, this compound is related to and has similar effects to 25b-NBOMe. It is significantly more potent than 2C-B  but less potent than 25B-NBOMe. Overdoses of NBOH compounds may cause  dangerous vasoconstriction. The drug may induce uncomfortable body load.

pharmacology.text: 25B-NBOH acts as a potent serotonin receptor agonist with similar affinity to the better-known compound 25B-NBOMe at 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors with affinities (Ki) of 5.0 nM and 0.40 nM, respectively. It fully substitutes for DOM in rodent drug discrimination tests, but with about 26-fold greater potency in comparison. The drug was also 18-fold more potent in substituting for DOM than 25B-NBOMe in rodents.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen
